meta.name: team-review
meta.description: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency using a team of persistent named reviewers. This skill should be used when the user says "team review", "review with team", or wants parallel code review with persistent team members for follow-up questions. Similar to /subagent-review but reviewers persist after review.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用团队审阅提升代码质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想在合并代码前获得多位审查者的反馈和建议。
copy.tagline_en: Improve code quality with team reviews
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want multiple reviewers' feedback before merging code.

howto.what: 当你说出特定关键词，Claude 会创建一个三人审查团队，并行检查你的代码变更，寻找可重用性、质量和效率问题，并直接修复这些问题。审查完成后，团队成员保留，以便你后续追问。
howto.when: 当你说“team review”、“review with team”等关键词，或者想要并行代码审查并允许后续提问时触发。

say.text: 帮我团队审查最近修改的代码。
问一下 reuse-reviewer 有没有更好的工具函数可替代。
say.note: 审查后直接向特定审查员追问具体问题。

howto.what_en: When you say a trigger phrase, Claude creates a team of three named reviewers who run in parallel to review your code changes for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fixes issues directly. The team persists for follow-up questions.
howto.when_en: When you say "team review", "review with team", or want parallel code review with persistent team members for follow-up questions.

say_en.note: Claude runs git diff, spawns three parallel reviewers.

say_en.text: Ask the reuse-reviewer about helper alternatives.
say_en.note: After review, query a specific team member directly.
